title: Natural coherent tensor realization in the full Roos model
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l and a scheme W in universe u. Write G for flat-term K-flat completed-module complexes, q_G for their localization, r^c for the specified ordinary coherent reduction on arbitrary unbounded complexes, T_s for the specified sequence total tensor, U^c for exact simultaneous scalar restriction, J for reordering complexes of towers, and B_tensor for the actual strict finite-tensor tower functor. Assume a proof hR that r^c(P) is K-flat for every P in G, and a natural isomorphism t: (r^c × r^c);T_s;U^c;J ≅ B_tensor. Construct a natural isomorphism (q_G × q_G);((R_W × R_W);tensor_s^L;L_W) ≅ integralOperationsTensorOnGood(l,E,W). Its component at good P,Q is exactly L_W(m_P tensor m_Q), followed by L_W of the inverse prescribed K-flat sequence tensor model for r^c(P),r^c(Q), the exact restriction/localization and full fixed Roos comparison, and q_W H_W(t_(P,Q)). Here m is the fixed adjunction-normalized reduction model and L_W the specified derived limit. This is a real composite of those specified natural isomorphisms and retains the full Roos differential and both cone coordinates; it uses no finite-projection detection principle. The auxiliary component theorem states the displayed formula as equality of isomorphisms.

source.place: Tag 07A4, lemma-pullback-tensor-product; Tag 0941, the ringed sequence site

proof.text: Use hR to lift ordinary coherent reduction on good complexes to the K-flat full subcategory. Whisker the product of the fixed natural reduction models by the derived sequence tensor and limit. Follow this by the inverse fixed K-flat tensor-model comparison whiskered along that lift and limit.

Apply the exact scalar-restriction localization factorization and then the full fixed Roos comparison; whisker along the total tensor of the two ordinary reductions. Finally whisker the supplied strict tower natural isomorphism t by Roos and localization. Compose the four natural isomorphisms.

Evaluate that composite at (P,Q). The component rules for whiskering and the definition of the K-flat tensor model give exactly the stated four-factor full Roos component formula. The equality is proved by isomorphism extensionality and definitional reduction.
